summary: Short kerb on a busy Fig Tree Pocket Road with no parking and no pull-out.

drivers.seclusion: Bush on the west side, but the van would sit in the traffic lane.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerb abuts the lane with a barrier-like edge and bush behind; nowhere to pull fully out.
drivers.traffic: Busy multi-lane through road with turning lane markings.
drivers.convention: No cars parked along this kerb; only moving traffic seen.

flags: Low-lying: Cubberla Creek 58 m away, about 15 m elevation
sun_shade: Bush to the west shades the afternoon; open to the east.
